response.original_title: ⟪Passenger™FAQ⟫ How to Add a New Guest to Your Royal Caribbean Cruises Reservation?
response.overview: To add a guest to a Royal Caribbean Cruise 1-877-525-6540 (US) or 44-800-652-9730 (UK), you must call Royal Caribbean Customer Service or contact your travel agent directly at 1-877-525-6540 (US) or 44-800-652-9730 (UK), as additions cannot be made online or through the mobile app. You cannot add a guest to a Royal Caribbean Cruise 1-877-525-6540 (US) or 44-800-652-9730 (UK) online, so you must contact Royal Caribbean customer service or your travel agent directly by phone  1-877-525-6540. To add another guest to an existing Royal Caribbean Cruise 1-877-525-6540 (US) or 44-800-652-9730 (UK) booking, you must call customer service directly or contact your travel advisor, as additions cannot be made online.
